name: My Mother Kyoko - NTR Fallen
source:
The main characters are Ryota and his mother Kyoko. She is a married woman with a child but her life is about to change...
Will Ryota be able to protect the relationship he has with his mother or is it already too late?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/azienda]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事的主角是Ryota与他的母亲Kyoko。她是一位育有孩子的已婚女性，然而，她的生活即将发生改变……
Ryota能够守护自己与母亲之间的关系吗？还是说，一切已经太迟了？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/azienda]Patreon[/url]]
